node.title: Budget-three fiber-two matched-cycle lifts descend to the prime field
node.statement: On the two-antipodal-denominator subbranch of the matched c=0 generic fiber-two cycle boundary at M=2^36 and N=2^39, a parameter-uniform Fourier resultant excludes the official prime-field branch and the quadratic p=-1 branch, leaving q_field=p^2 with p=1 mod 2^40. The even-factorization coefficients and outer roots descend to F_p under this weaker congruence. In the nonsplit class modulo 2^41, Frobenius sends a possible top lift r to +/-r; conjugating the three exact Mobius-ratio equations excludes the -r case. Hence every surviving normalized source lift and the Mobius matching lie over F_p. This does not exclude the boundary or transfer the later scalar, Jacobi, and norm gates.
